title: About
text:
Hi! My name is Alina. I am a data professional, specialising in data analytics data visualisation data engineering computer vision databases web applications all things data, actually. At present, I work as a consultant in the United Nations system, building data products to advance evidence-based decision-making. I program in Python and sometimes in R, and also occasionally contribute to open-source projects.
In addition to my two master’s degrees in quantitative social sciences, I hold an MSc in Big Data and Professional Diploma in Artificial Intelligence for Computer Vision. I am currently pursuing a PhD at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam in the Netherlands. My research project focuses on applying computer vision to satellite imagery and geospatial data for the Sustainable Development Goals monitoring.
Originally from Ukraine, I now live in Southern Europe ☀️. Outside of work, I enjoy hiking, running, and exploring new places.
Follow me on GitHub or get in touch with me using the links below.

title: Welcome To My Blog
text:
I plan to use this space to share my thoughts about data science tools and practices that I find interesting and useful. You can expect to see topics ranging from data analytics and visualisation to computer vision – with an emphasis on applications for social good.
Also, I commit to post original content with a minimal and ethical use of GenAI.
Stay tuned for more!
